objective: Make tool execution attempts durable, fenced and reconcilable across duplicate delivery, worker crash, timeout and restart.
root_cause: Idempotency reservation, side effect, outcome, audit, result publication and event acknowledgment were separate operations without an execution-attempt lifecycle.
Synchronous tools could outlive worker heartbeat and source event leases.
attempt_lifecycle: RESERVED -> RUNNING -> SUCCEEDED | FAILED | TIMED_OUT | NEEDS_RECONCILIATION; publication and acknowledgment are durable flags. Each attempt has a UUID and source/authority/workspace/operation attribution.
persistence_changes: SQLiteMailStore atomically reserves an attempt plus idempotency key; atomically writes fenced outcome, tool audit and key result; atomically publishes one result event; atomically acknowledges source event and attempt.
schema_changes: Idempotent execution_attempts table and state/lease index added to schema.sql. Existing SQLite data is preserved; pre-WP2 migration tested.
idempotency_behavior: One attempt per source request and key; active duplicate does not run; terminal duplicate returns durable result; RESERVED may resume; allow_duplicate bypass denied; legacy keys without attempts require reconciliation; no implicit failure retry.
lease_behavior: Worker heartbeat renews source event lease during synchronous work. Gateway renews running attempt lease during subprocess work. Intervals derive from configured lease duration.
fencing_behavior: Monotonic generation, owner and unexpired attempt lease are required for outcome; durable source events additionally require the same live event lease. Expired RUNNING is fenced and unknown.
timeout_behavior: Monotonic command deadline, process-tree termination and durable TIMED_OUT result. Windows Job Object kills descendants on handle close or worker crash; taskkill handles timeout. Nonzero exit is FAILED.
reconciliation_behavior: Startup leaves unstarted RESERVED and valid RUNNING; expired RUNNING becomes NEEDS_RECONCILIATION; recorded outcomes publish once; published outcomes acknowledge when source lease permits; redelivery reuses stored outcome.
unknown_outcome_policy: Never auto-replay a started attempt without a durable outcome. Unknown effects require investigation and new explicit authorization before further work.
